gates.title: Canonical Completeness
gates.purpose: Verify that every mandatory release input has a canonical source and no missing specification is hidden by a PASS.
requiredEvidence: Product/Architecture/Queue/State/Context/Gap/Flag/Rollback source map
missing-spec register
gates.exitRule: Every required source exists or is explicitly blocked with an Owner decision.

gates.title: Functional Completeness
gates.purpose: Evaluate every new Platform domain by observed product behavior, not source-file presence.
requiredEvidence: domain success/failure/recovery evidence
cross-tool integration evidence
gates.exitRule: The rollout scope has no unresolved functional P0/P1 item.

gates.title: UX and Device Readiness
gates.purpose: Validate real devices, browsers, input methods, accessibility, and Pixel-Art workflow.
requiredEvidence: device/browser matrix
Aseprite and current-mobile comparison
gates.exitRule: Every supported device/browser/input combination has required evidence.

gates.title: Performance and Memory
gates.purpose: Validate full compositor latency, Long Tasks, memory, bundle/request boundaries, and scale fixtures.
requiredEvidence: formal p50/p95/max
memory/Long Task/raw-result evidence
gates.exitRule: Performance budgets pass on each supported scope or the scope remains unavailable.

gates.title: Legacy Compatibility
gates.purpose: Prove non-destructive compatibility with legacy PXD, Projects, PiXiSYNC, Market, Commerce, and Social data.
requiredEvidence: read-only source hash/visual/reconciliation evidence
old/new client coexistence evidence
gates.exitRule: Affected legacy records remain resolvable with rollback proof.

gates.title: Security Permission and RLS
gates.purpose: Validate server authority, RLS/RPC, private visibility, safe paths, providers, and secret/PII boundaries.
requiredEvidence: Production-equivalent denied/allowed/RLS/RPC tests
webhook/replay/idempotency evidence
gates.exitRule: No P0 security or privacy gap remains for the rollout scope.

gates.title: Production Integration Rehearsal
gates.purpose: Rehearse adapters and controls in an isolated Production-equivalent environment without changing Production.
requiredEvidence: migration/storage dry-run
route/flag/kill/monitor/provider-adapter rehearsal
gates.exitRule: All required rehearsals are reproducible and fail closed.

gates.title: Migration and Rollback Rehearsal
gates.purpose: Apply the normative L0–L8 migration gates to an isolated rehearsal.
requiredEvidence: backup/restore
identity/data/money/reconciliation/rollback evidence
gates.exitRule: Required L0–L8 gates pass for any proposed migration scope.

gates.title: Limited Rollout Readiness
gates.purpose: Define cohort, flags, thresholds, monitoring, rollback ownership, and observation without rolling out.
requiredEvidence: staged rollout plan
rollback trigger/owner/observation window
gates.exitRule: Owner receives an evidence-backed limited-rollout plan after G0–G7 evaluation.

gates.title: Owner Release Approval
gates.purpose: Present the evidence and a non-automatic decision request to the Owner.
requiredEvidence: signed acceptance summary
independent review/legal/accounting evidence where applicable
gates.exitRule: Only the Owner may select READY_FOR_LIMITED_ROLLOUT, NOT_READY, or BLOCKED.

acceptanceItems.title: Product specifications and reconstruction provenance
requiredEvidence: All release-scope product specifications and reconstruction status reviewed.

acceptanceItems.title: Architecture, permission, storage, feature-flag, and rollback contracts
requiredEvidence: No required contract is missing or contradicted for the proposed scope.

acceptanceItems.title: Queue, State, Context Map, predecessor definitions, and Context
requiredEvidence: Dependency graph and mandatory input map are structurally valid.

acceptanceItems.title: All existing Gap Inventory status references are aggregated
requiredEvidence: Every scanned source status is retained with a source reference.

acceptanceItems.title: Production-equivalent environment, observability, and release-operation specifications
requiredEvidence: Owner-approved missing-spec register and an environment-specific verification plan.

acceptanceItems.title: Separate lazy-bundle baseline and measurement definition
requiredEvidence: Raw/minified/gzip/Brotli baseline per chunk with source maps excluded.

acceptanceItems.title: Professional Pixel Editing workflow and recovery
requiredEvidence: Operational Pencil/Selection/Timeline/Onion/Advanced Tool success, cancel, undo, and recovery evidence.

acceptanceItems.title: Audio project and asset workflow
requiredEvidence: Real audio asset workflow and browser/device integration evidence.

acceptanceItems.title: Game authoring and Draw/Audio revision consumption
requiredEvidence: Cross-tool create/revise/preview/recover evidence.

acceptanceItems.title: Runtime execution, Save State, and package compatibility
requiredEvidence: Full runtime E2E, capability fallback, and save-state compatibility evidence.

acceptanceItems.title: Project, Asset, Package, Search, and Notification integration
requiredEvidence: Cross-domain create to revise to package to recover flow evidence.

acceptanceItems.title: Market Product, Rights, Purchase, Entitlement, Royalty, and Ledger projection
requiredEvidence: Production-equivalent purchase/entitlement/reconciliation evidence.

acceptanceItems.title: Request, Quote, Agreement, Delivery, Rights, and Billing separation
requiredEvidence: Production-equivalent state-flow, money, and reconciliation evidence.

acceptanceItems.title: Social, Community, Creator, and Market Card behavior
requiredEvidence: Real-data-compatible social lifecycle, visibility, and recovery evidence.

acceptanceItems.title: Admin Projection and Audit separation
requiredEvidence: Server-authorized projection and non-replayable audit evidence.

acceptanceItems.title: Analytics, Public Ads, Cost, Revenue Shadow, and Sponsored Search
requiredEvidence: Consent/region/provider adapter, privacy, and shadow-only revenue evidence.

acceptanceItems.title: No domain is marked product-complete from source presence alone
requiredEvidence: Recorded user-visible success/failure/recovery evidence per enabled scope.

acceptanceItems.title: Unannounced advanced-tool polish remains post-launch unless explicitly included in rollout scope
requiredEvidence: If enabled for a release cohort, reclassify to P0/P1 and collect operational evidence first.

acceptanceItems.title: Desktop and Tablet authoring readiness
requiredEvidence: Real device/browser matrix and keyboard workflow evidence.

acceptanceItems.title: Physical Mobile Canvas-first and Touch readiness
requiredEvidence: Physical mobile draw/pan/pinch/panel/timeline test evidence.

acceptanceItems.title: Physical Stylus, pressure, cancel, and pointer-capture readiness
requiredEvidence: Physical stylus and interruption/lost-capture evidence.

acceptanceItems.title: Keyboard, shortcuts, focus, and drag alternatives
requiredEvidence: Keyboard-only authoring and modal/sheet shortcut-suppression evidence.

acceptanceItems.title: Real Screen Reader semantics and recovery
requiredEvidence: Real Screen Reader walkthrough with names, states, focus, and errors.

acceptanceItems.title: Chromium reference browser evidence
requiredEvidence: Versioned Chromium device/browser result for enabled scope.

acceptanceItems.title: Safari and Firefox supported-browser evidence
requiredEvidence: Versioned Safari and Firefox result or explicit unsupported-scope decision.

acceptanceItems.title: Aseprite-level basic workflow and Current PiXiEEDraw Mobile comparison
requiredEvidence: Observed operation-step, shortcut, cancel, feedback, and reachability comparison.

acceptanceItems.title: Desktop full-compositor Input-to-Visible p50/p95/max
requiredEvidence: 512x512, 20 layers, 120 frames actual-device p95 <= 24ms evidence.

acceptanceItems.title: Mobile full-compositor Input-to-Visible p50/p95/max
requiredEvidence: 256x256, 12 layers, 60 frames actual-device p95 <= 32ms evidence.

acceptanceItems.title: Routine Long Task and cause classification
requiredEvidence: No routine editing Main Thread Long Task over 50ms and classified root cause evidence.

acceptanceItems.title: Thirty-minute component memory and cache boundaries
requiredEvidence: 30-minute raster/tile/history/timeline/cache/resource memory result.

acceptanceItems.title: Initial Bundle, lazy chunks, request count, and source-map policy
requiredEvidence: Per-chunk raw/minified/gzip/Brotli and unauthorized-chunk request result.

acceptanceItems.title: Runtime startup and Game/Audio asset loading
requiredEvidence: Actual-device startup, loading, failure, fallback, and memory result.

acceptanceItems.title: 1000 Frame and 100 Layer virtualization
requiredEvidence: Full compositor visible-item, overscan, DOM, and interaction result.

acceptanceItems.title: Renderer, Worker, Tile, and candidate technology decision
requiredEvidence: Same-fixture measured win and safe Canvas2D/WebGL2/Worker fallback; WebGPU/Wasm/SAB are optional.

acceptanceItems.title: Real Legacy PXD import, visual/hash round-trip, and source preservation
requiredEvidence: Read-only real or sanitized Production-equivalent Legacy PXD fixture comparison.

acceptanceItems.title: Existing User Project and actual-device import
requiredEvidence: Owner-approved sanitized Project fixtures and device import/recovery evidence.

acceptanceItems.title: Current PiXiSYNC old/new coexistence, Checkpoint, Realtime, and rollback
requiredEvidence: Old/new client coexistence, reorder/delay, Checkpoint authorization, and rollback convergence evidence.

acceptanceItems.title: PXD, Asset Revision, Package, and dependency compatibility
requiredEvidence: Hash, dependency, missing-reference, and recovery comparison.

acceptanceItems.title: Legacy Market Product and public URL compatibility
requiredEvidence: Read-only product/file/hash/URL comparison with current data contract.

acceptanceItems.title: Purchase, Entitlement, License, Royalty, and Payout evidence
requiredEvidence: Production-equivalent entitlement/right/money/payout reconciliation.

acceptanceItems.title: Legacy Social/Post/Comment and Market-adjacent data
requiredEvidence: Source table/RLS/dependency inventory and read-only compatibility comparison.

acceptanceItems.title: Original data retention, source hashes, and no destructive conversion
requiredEvidence: Original-plus-converted-copy, alias/map, retention, and rollback proof.

acceptanceItems.title: Auth, RLS, RPC authorization, and fail-closed server authority
requiredEvidence: Production-equivalent allowed/denied RLS/RPC test results per resource/action.

acceptanceItems.title: Admin and Moderation server authority and audit separation
requiredEvidence: Server actor, case/decision, audit, and no automatic destructive mutation evidence.

acceptanceItems.title: Private/Public visibility, Search leak prevention, and Social leak prevention
requiredEvidence: Private/deleted/quarantined/unauthorized denial and index/tombstone evidence.

acceptanceItems.title: Safe URL, archive/path, and upload validation
requiredEvidence: Path traversal, archive, MIME, URL, and upload deny fixtures in the proposed environment.

acceptanceItems.title: Payment webhook signature, replay, ordering, and idempotency
requiredEvidence: Verified signature, timestamp, environment, replay, duplicate, and out-of-order provider tests.

acceptanceItems.title: JWT, secrets, PII, payment detail, and creative-content telemetry exclusion
requiredEvidence: Log/audit/analytics redaction inspection and failure fixtures.

acceptanceItems.title: Database migration dry-run and reconciliation plan
requiredEvidence: Isolated database backup/restore, dry-run, and reconciliation output.

acceptanceItems.title: Storage inventory, copy/re-link, hash, and restore dry-run
requiredEvidence: Bucket/object inventory, byte hash, isolated restore, and access-policy validation.

acceptanceItems.title: Route compatibility, Feature Flag, Kill Switch, and current-path fallback
requiredEvidence: Read/write fallback, unauthorized-before-flag, kill, rollback, and current-route results.

acceptanceItems.title: Monitoring, mismatch, error, performance, and recovery observability
requiredEvidence: Non-sensitive dashboards, thresholds, alerts, correlation, and recovery exercise.

acceptanceItems.title: Consent, Ads, Analytics, and Payment adapter rehearsal
requiredEvidence: Isolated provider adapter, consent/region policy, failure, and no-Ledger-mutation evidence.

acceptanceItems.title: L0/L1 inventory, backup, checksum, and restore proof
requiredEvidence: Verified isolated database/Storage/Stripe restore results.

acceptanceItems.title: L2 identity mapping and account continuity
requiredEvidence: 100 percent mapped identity and zero duplicate/ownership-change evidence.

acceptanceItems.title: L3 products, files, URLs, price, and license retention
requiredEvidence: Active-product, file-hash, URL, price, and license reconciliation.

acceptanceItems.title: L4/L5 entitlement and money reconciliation
requiredEvidence: Zero-orphan entitlement and zero-tolerance money/payout reconciliation.

acceptanceItems.title: L6/L7 shadow operation, single writer, user experience, and rollback
requiredEvidence: Zero backlog/missing event, rollback flag, support trace, and preserved accepted-write proof.

acceptanceItems.title: L8 retention, archive/restore, payout cycles, and approval
requiredEvidence: Two payout cycles, fallback window, archive/restore, legal/accounting, Owner, and independent-review evidence.

acceptanceItems.title: Cohort and eligibility definition
requiredEvidence: Server-controlled deterministic cohort and explicit scope exclusions.

acceptanceItems.title: Read/write Feature Flag and current-path fallback plan
requiredEvidence: Default-OFF, separate read/write, authorization ordering, and Kill Switch plan.

acceptanceItems.title: Error, mismatch, security, and performance thresholds
requiredEvidence: Measured threshold values and stop/rollback trigger definitions.

acceptanceItems.title: Rollback trigger, Owner, recovery path, and observation window
requiredEvidence: Named authorized rollback operator, testable command/procedure, and observation window.

acceptanceItems.title: Current PiXiEED fallback and no-data-loss posture
requiredEvidence: Current Draw/Market/URLs/data fallback remains usable throughout rehearsal.

acceptanceItems.title: Evidence-backed readiness decision
requiredEvidence: Matrix decision is READY_FOR_LIMITED_ROLLOUT, NOT_READY, or BLOCKED with cited evidence.

acceptanceItems.title: Owner Approval Request is explicit and non-automatic
requiredEvidence: Owner request packet; no automated approval or release action.

acceptanceItems.title: Independent review and legal/accounting approval where applicable
requiredEvidence: Independent reviewer and legal/accounting evidence for any affected scope.
